item.title: Topological Spaces
item.description: Topological Space Definition Given a set X, a pair of sets (X, \mathcal{O}) is called a topological space if \mathcal{O} is a family/ collection of subsets of X that satisfies the following properties: \emptyset \in \mathcal{O} and X \in \mathcal{O}.
